sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm two-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand the capacity pressure described in your letter of 18 September 2026 (doc:20260918-70410-P10). It says you will prioritise customers with firm, long-term commitments.

We would like to offer exactly that commitment. Our proposal:
- EUR 31.68/unit
- 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each year
- 24-month term
- 42-day lead time, the standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1)
- All other terms as enquired: DAP, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause, no tooling.

This pairs the recorded delivery standard with a firm two-year commitment covering our full annual allocation.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010). It is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Could you let us know whether this complete package is feasible for you? If any element is difficult under your current loading, we would appreciate understanding which one, so we can look for a workable structure together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm – firm two-year commitment proposal
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your proposal for a two-year commitment and increased volume. 

Our current offer comprises a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. As you anticipated, a 42-day lead time is not feasible under our current capacity loading. 

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Hollerau – three-year full-volume package for mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming that you took our cost estimate into account. We also note your point that 42 days is difficult under your current loading.

We would like to build on your 54-day alternative with the following complete package:
- EUR 31.07/unit
- 23,400 pcs per year, binding in each of three years
- 36-month term
- 54-day lead time
- Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause, no tooling; your standard quality terms otherwise.

Compared with our first proposal, we relax our requested delivery from 42 to 54 days and add a third binding year. In return, we seek EUR 31.07/unit. This trades price for the delivery flexibility and the longer, firm commitment that your letter of 18 September 2026 says you prioritise.

If you can confirm this package, we are ready to execute it on that basis. If one element does not work for you, please tell us which, and we will look at it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Hollerau – three-year full-volume package for mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your proposal to extend the contract term to 36 months and your acceptance of the 54-day lead time. In response to this longer commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.50 per unit. 

For clarity, our Angebot comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Before proceeding, please provide the data substantiating your volume projections for this extended period. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

proposal.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation. We understand that delivering full volume at 42 days would require significant changes to your current production schedule. We would like to ease that constraint rather than add to it.

We therefore propose a complete package of EUR 30.90/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, a 36-month term and 56 days lead time. Payment remains 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01. This moves us in three ways:
- We raise our proposed price from EUR 29.89.
- We add a third committed year.
- We accept 56 days lead time instead of the 42 days we requested, giving you more scheduling room.

Would this longer, firmer commitment allow you to set the unit price at EUR 30.90 for full allocation? If internal approval is needed, we would be glad to support your business case.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming 42 days for the full 23,400 units. We note that a lower price would need a longer lead time, and we are prepared to work with that.

We propose a choice of two new packages. Both are 23,400 units/year binding, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01:

A: 36 months, 56 days, EUR 30.90/unit.
B: 36 months, 42 days, EUR 31.60/unit.

Compared with our earlier proposals, Option A adds a third committed year and the longer lead time you indicated, at a higher price. Option B raises our three-year price while keeping 42 days. Both are new proposals that require your agreement.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is not your disclosed cost.

Would you ask your manager to approve this complete package as a commercial exception, with you remaining our lead?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for the clear answer. We take your point on lead time, so here are two packages, each for a binding 23,400 pcs/year:

A) 56 days, 24 months, EUR 30.30/unit
B) 42 days, 36 months, EUR 31.10/unit

Package A follows your advice on lead time. Its 56 days is longer than the 54 days in your opening quotation, so it needs no extraordinary planning. It also doubles that quotation's term and raises its annual volume.

Package B responds to your note that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments (doc:20260918-70410-P10). It offers three fixed years on a level monthly schedule, which you can plan into regular shifts rather than overtime.

We ordered 19,880 units in the last twelve months (p10:ordered_last_12m_units), so 23,400 is a larger binding volume, not a repeat of past call-offs. Our bottom-up estimate of your plant cost is EUR 24.31 before margin (cost:340010). That is a low-confidence buyer estimate, not a claim about your accounts.

Which package fits your capacity plan better?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

proposal.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation. We understand that delivering full volume at 42 days would require significant changes to your current production schedule. We would like to ease that constraint rather than add to it.

We therefore propose a complete package of EUR 30.90/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, a 36-month term and 56 days lead time. Payment remains 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01. This moves us in three ways:
- We raise our proposed price from EUR 29.89.
- We add a third committed year.
- We accept 56 days lead time instead of the 42 days we requested, giving you more scheduling room.

Would this longer, firmer commitment allow you to set the unit price at EUR 30.90 for full allocation? If internal approval is needed, we would be glad to support your business case.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming 42 days for the full 23,400 units. We note that a lower price would need a longer lead time, and we are prepared to work with that.

We propose a choice of two new packages. Both are 23,400 units/year binding, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01:

A: 36 months, 56 days, EUR 30.90/unit.
B: 36 months, 42 days, EUR 31.60/unit.

Compared with our earlier proposals, Option A adds a third committed year and the longer lead time you indicated, at a higher price. Option B raises our three-year price while keeping 42 days. Both are new proposals that require your agreement.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is not your disclosed cost.

Would you ask your manager to approve this complete package as a commercial exception, with you remaining our lead?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for the clear answer. We take your point on lead time, so here are two packages, each for a binding 23,400 pcs/year:

A) 56 days, 24 months, EUR 30.30/unit
B) 42 days, 36 months, EUR 31.10/unit

Package A follows your advice on lead time. Its 56 days is longer than the 54 days in your opening quotation, so it needs no extraordinary planning. It also doubles that quotation's term and raises its annual volume.

Package B responds to your note that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments (doc:20260918-70410-P10). It offers three fixed years on a level monthly schedule, which you can plan into regular shifts rather than overtime.

We ordered 19,880 units in the last twelve months (p10:ordered_last_12m_units), so 23,400 is a larger binding volume, not a repeat of past call-offs. Our bottom-up estimate of your plant cost is EUR 24.31 before margin (cost:340010). That is a low-confidence buyer estimate, not a claim about your accounts.

Which package fits your capacity plan better?

Best regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
